story.title: Democrats Achieve Largest House Majority Since 1992 with 258 Seats
story.summary: Democrats have secured a historic majority in the House of Representatives, reaching at least 258 seats, the largest since 1992. This milestone was confirmed following the victory of Democrat Chuck Hubbard over Republican Rep. Virginia Foxx in North Carolina.

timeline_highlights.summary: Democrat Chuck Hubbard has defeated Republican Representative Virginia Foxx in a North Carolina House race following a recount. This victory marks a significant shift in a district that has been held by Foxx for 11 terms, contributing to the Democrats' largest majority in the House since 1992.

event_overview.title: About US House Majority
event_overview.subject: US House Majority
event_overview.summary: This event concerns the 2026 election for North Carolina’s 5th Congressional District, a contest for one seat in the U.S. House of Representatives. The closely decided race drew attention because its outcome contributes to the partisan composition and control of the House for the next Congress.

facts.label: Election date
facts.value: North Carolina held its 2026 statewide general election on November 3, 2026; all 14 of the state’s U.S. House seats were on the ballot.

facts.label: Office and candidates
facts.value: The contest was for U.S. House District 5. The state candidate list identifies Democrat Charles Noble “Chuck” Hubbard, Republican Virginia Foxx, and Libertarian Robert B. Luffman as candidates.

facts.label: Election administration and recount rule
facts.value: The North Carolina State Board of Elections has jurisdiction over this nonstatewide congressional contest. State law permits a candidate to demand a recount when the margin is no more than 1% of votes cast; Foxx requested one after the county canvasses reported a 331-vote margin.

facts.label: Congressional term
facts.value: House members serve two-year terms; under the Twentieth Amendment, the terms of incoming representatives begin at noon on January 3, so the election determines representation for the Congress beginning in January 2027.

event_overview.scope_note: This Muninn timeline follows the Hubbard–Foxx result and its relevance to the U.S. House majority, not every North Carolina race, statewide election issue, recount procedure, or subsequent action in Congress.
